name: Buffet Hot Porridge Bar (Grits, Farina, or White Rice Congee)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Cabanas and Marceline Market stock hot Cream of Wheat/farina, hominy grits, and individual boxes of Rice Krispies/Corn Flakes alongside lactose-free/oat milk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: On a rough flare morning at sea, grab hot Cream of Wheat/grits or a bowl of Rice Krispies with oat/soy/lactose-free milk and a ripe banana or melon slices.
watchOuts: Avoid the Muesli / Bircher muesli (raw rolled oats, nuts, and dried fruit skins)
